mechanism: Train a multi-head discriminator that, from current market+account state alone, predicts next account-state vectors for every skill z; intrinsic agent reward is log(|mean(forecast_z / mean_over_skills)|) assigned to the action implied by Δposition—balancing skill predictability (numerator) against behavioral diversity (denominator).
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr price/indicator window; relative AccountDescr; one-hot or full skill vector; next-bar close for calculated account transition; NSkills forecast heads.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD defaults; train Jan–Apr 2023, test May 2023
why_new_for_mis: Turns skill labels into a dynamics-aware regime sensor: skills are rewarded only when their induced next-state is both reachable and atypical vs the skill average—usable as a regime/behavior codebook with predictability scores.
quote: Using such a reward function allows us to solve the problem posed above. Since in the numerator we use the predicted state for the current skill, we reward the agent action that leads to achieving the predicted state.

mechanism: Scheduler SoftMax outputs a full probability distribution over NSkills from market+account state; pass the entire distribution (not argmax) into the agent so regime membership is soft/blurred rather than a hard skill ID.
data_needed: Same state vector as DADS agent; SoftMax over NSkills; optional greedy vs full-distribution ablation.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; May 2023 OOS; uniform skill usage in test
why_new_for_mis: Soft skill posterior is a continuous multi-regime membership vector—MIS can treat it as a fuzzy regime embedding instead of a single discrete regime tag.
quote: Under such conditions, the decision arises to transfer the full probability distribution to the agent for decision making.

mechanism: Explore→Discover→Learn: train a VAE on (history+account)→latent skill z (mean+variance via reparameterization)→decode only next account state; agent then acts from latent z alone; intrinsic reward can be −‖decoded_account − realized_account_after_action‖² (Euclidean closeness to decoder target).
data_needed: Uniform state coverage buffer; VAE encoder/decoder; LatentLayer=NSkills; account-relative targets with open/close thresholds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train first 4 months 2023, test May 2023; mix of profitable and losing passes
why_new_for_mis: Unsupervised state→skill latent from a VAE is a neural regime ID discovered without labels—MIS can read z (and its variance) as a compressed market-state skill sensor.
quote: In the latent state of the auto encoder, we expect to obtain the identification of a latent skill that follows from the current state of the environment.

mechanism: Split sensing: convolutional VAE-style encoder on HistoryBars×BarDescr only forms a latent skill for rising/falling/flat context; concatenate-layer injects AccountDescr as the local subtask (flat inventory ⇒ seek entry; open volume ⇒ seek exit); FQF head chooses discrete actions conditioned on both.
data_needed: Price/indicator history without account into encoder; relative balance/equity/volumes/profits + position_discount into second stream.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 4 months 2023, test 1–18 Jun 2023
why_new_for_mis: Separates market-regime skill sensing from goal/subtask sensing (entry vs exit)—MIS can run parallel regime and inventory-goal channels instead of one fused state.
quote: We assume that the scheduler (in this case, the encoder) will form the skill to be used based on historical data. This can be a policy of working in a rising, falling or flat market.

mechanism: Per open position accumulate position_discount −= (now−open_time)·(1/(3600·10))·|POSITION_PROFIT|; when inventory>0 add this to reward (penalize long holds of large |PnL|); when flat subtract ATR to push entries—exit-pressure / hold-regime sensor.
data_needed: Position open times, volumes, profits; ATR; account description slot for discount.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 GCRL test; max hold ~21h15, avg ~5h49 after penalty
why_new_for_mis: Time×|PnL| holding pressure is a continuous change/exit-urgency feature MIS can use without waiting for fixed time stops.
quote: As such an indicator, we propose to use the sum of the absolute values of the accumulated profit/loss weighted by the duration of the open position.

mechanism: Adaptive variational GCRL: divide each skill’s deviation from target by that skill’s VAE latent variance so low-variance (confident state–skill) links dominate learning and high-variance skills contribute less noise.
data_needed: VAE latent means and variances per skill from encoder; skill target errors.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Conceptual aVGCRL on top of EDL VAE scheduler; EURUSD H1 stack
why_new_for_mis: Per-skill latent variance is a confidence weight on regime assignment—MIS can trust tight-variance skills and downweight ambiguous regimes.
quote: The authors of the aVGCRL method propose dividing the deviation error for each skill from the target value by the dispersion of the distribution.

mechanism: Soft Actor-Critic adds −α log π(a|s) entropy regularization to rewards; temperature α (fixed, annealed, or learned per-action via sigmoid) balances exploration vs exploitation; GetLogProbs from FQF quantile/probability layers yields a continuous uncertainty/diversity score of the policy at the current state.
data_needed: Stochastic actor outputs; quantile probs; α or learned alphas; cumulative reward with entropy term.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 Jan–May 2023 train/test; continuous lot/SL/TP actions
why_new_for_mis: Policy entropy at state s is a live uncertainty/exploration sensor—high H flags unfamiliar or contested regimes for MIS caution sizing.
quote: The main goal of SAC is to maximize the expected reward given the maximum entropy of the policy, which allows finding a variety of optimal solutions in stochastic environments.

mechanism: Move calendar features out of per-bar state into the account stream once per bar: encode time via sin/cos of fractions of year, month (PERIOD_MN1), week (PERIOD_W1), and day (PERIOD_D1) over 2π—normalized cyclic seasonality sensors without repeating stamps on every candle.
data_needed: Bar time; PeriodSeconds for D1/W1/MN1; year span constant; AccountDescr extended (~12).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 SAC; Jan–May 2023 train, Jun 2023 OOS
why_new_for_mis: Compact multi-scale cyclic time embedding as a session/seasonality regime feature—MIS calendar context without one-hot hour/day explosion.
quote: To normalize the timestamp and take the cyclical nature into account, we need to: Divide the current time by the period size; Multiply … by 2π; Calculate sin or cos.

mechanism: Train an autoencoder on Critic latent (state–action embedding); reconstruction error ψ(s,a) is intrinsic novelty—high on unseen pairs, →0 as pairs are learned; replace SAC entropy with ψ, with dynamic temperature α=σ(ω·Q/(max_err−min_err+ε))-style schedule from Critic error stats.
data_needed: Critic latent buffer; AE encode/decode; reconstruction MSE; Critic Q for α; Actor continuous actions via VAE layer.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train first 5 months 2023, test Jun 2023
why_new_for_mis: Reconstruction error as a visit-novelty / familiarity sensor for (market state, action) pairs—MIS can flag under-explored regimes without needing action probabilities.
quote: It is the data copying error that we will use as a measure of the knowledge of a separate "State-Action" pair.

mechanism: From twin Critics compute mean μ and std σ of Q(s,a); optimistic upper bound QUB=μ+β_UB·σ drives explorer actor πe; lower bound QLB=μ−β_LB·σ (β_LB=1 ⇒ min Q) trains conservative target πt; SAC+DICE adds ζ(s,a) distribution-correction weights so off-policy gradients stay unbiased as πe diverges from the buffer.
data_needed: Two Critic nets + targets; β_UB/β_LB; DICE nets ζ,v and Lagrange λ; replay buffer.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 SAC+DICE stack; OOS profit reported after iterative collect/train
why_new_for_mis: QUB−QLB spread is an epistemic uncertainty band on value—MIS can treat wide bands as regime/action ambiguity and prefer conservative QLB.
quote: This allowed the principle of optimism to be used in the uncertainty of performing directed research using an upper bound. At the same time, the lower limit helps to avoid overestimating actions.

mechanism: Emit one Q-head per reward component (balance Δ, equity Δ, flat penalty, …); train each with the SAC/DICE base update but pick the Critic with min total Q for component targets; combine with weights W_i and Conflict-Averse Gradient Descent so conflicting component gradients do not cancel.
data_needed: Vector reward R_i per transition; multi-output Critic; CAGrad c∈[0,1); component weights.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; decomposed rewards in SAC-D&DICE; train 5 months 2023
why_new_for_mis: Component-wise Q values are diagnostic sensors of which objective (PnL vs drawdown vs activity) currently dominates—MIS attribution of regime drivers.
quote: Using value decomposition, the Agent learns an importance function for each reward component.

mechanism: Freeze a randomly initialized convolutional encoder; store low-dim embeddings of (history+account+action) in the replay buffer; intrinsic reward ∝ log(‖y−y_kNN‖₂+1) from k-NN distance in that fixed space (state entropy proxy); anneal β·r_int over training.
data_needed: Fixed random conv encoder; embedding buffer; k-NN L2; external reward + β schedule.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; first 5 months 2023; few high-quality trades in test
why_new_for_mis: Fixed random embedding + k-NN distance is a cheap novelty/entropy sensor without training a dynamics model—MIS exploration/familiarity feature for high-dim bar states.
quote: The main idea of RE3 is to estimate entropy using the estimator k nearest neighbors in a low-dimensional space obtained using a randomly initialized encoder.

mechanism: Contrastive Intrinsic Control: CPC-style discriminator scores agreement between state-transition (s→s′) embeddings and skill vectors z; maximize transition entropy for behavioral diversity then instantiate skills so states remain predictable given z; two-stage train (skill pretrain without external reward → scheduler finetune with external reward).
data_needed: Separate state encoder; skill projector; contrastive discriminator; continuous-action actor; skill scheduler.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; first 5 months 2023; hierarchical skill+scheduler training
why_new_for_mis: Contrastive MI between transitions and skills yields a skill bank grounded in what actually changed in the market—stronger unsupervised regime vocabulary than skill-ID priors alone.
quote: The method handles transitions between states and skill vectors. This allows for powerful representation learning techniques from visual processing to skill detection.

mechanism: Build matrix S whose rows are the current encoded state and its (n−1) k-NN neighbors; intrinsic reward = λ·‖S‖_★/‖S‖_F (nuclear over Frobenius), with λ from matrix shape—promotes diverse (high-rank) neighborhoods while damping entropy collapse and L2-squared noise sensitivity; plug into RE3-style loop with decomposed rewards including an NNM slot.
data_needed: Encoded state matrix n×m; SVD/nuclear norm; Frobenius norm; k-NN retrieval; reward vector slot 3=NNM.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 1–5 months 2023; ~1% OOS month with 133 trades after NNM+RE3
why_new_for_mis: Nuclear/Frobenius novelty is a noise-robust diversity sensor on local state clouds—MIS can use it as an exploration/regime-coverage score less spike-sensitive than raw L2 k-NN.
quote: Such an internal reward is able to evaluate the novelty of environmental exploration more accurately. At the same time, it allows for high immunity to noise and spikes.

mechanism: DDPG Actor runs batch-norm+conv compression of HistoryBars×BarDescr then concatenates AccountDescr; Critic consumes the Actor’s mid-network latent (not raw bars) plus continuous actions (lot, SL, TP × buy/sell)—shared compressed market embedding as the value sensor.
data_needed: OHLC diffs, RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD; account vector; LatentLayer id; continuous 6-D action.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 from early 2023; online tester training ~3000 passes
why_new_for_mis: Explicit reusable latent market embedding shared by policy and value nets—MIS can tap the same compressed state representation as a neural regime/features sensor.
quote: Remember the ID of this layer and the size of the vector of its results. It is from this layer that we will take the latent representation of the state of the environment as the Critic’s initial data.

mechanism: While training the EDL VAE decoder, replace pure reconstruction with a desired next-account target under rules (min profit to open, wait small moves, close opposite before reverse)—decoder becomes a supervised behavior-prior forecast of account evolution the agent then imitates.
data_needed: Next-bar profit per lot; thresholds ±5/±10; GetNewState account roll-forward; decoder target = relative account vector.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 EDL; alternative StudyActor2 with balance Δ reward beat decoder-imitation
why_new_for_mis: Rule-shaped account-state target is a change/behavior prior sensor—MIS can compare realized vs desired account trajectory as a policy-adherence or regime-health signal.
quote: Thus, we want to form a predictive model with the desired behavior.
